findings.text: the Deliverable renames `test_temp_config_home` but says nothing about the `# noqa: PT028` on that signature, and PT028 only fires on a pytest-collected name, so the rename turns the directive unused; with `RUF` selected in `[tool.ruff.lint]` this yields `RUF100 Unused noqa directive (unused: PT028)` on `tests/conftest.py`, a staged path, which the section's own done-when ("Ruff, counted by delta on the staged paths against the base, adds no finding") forbids

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: pass — `tests/conftest.py` (the helper at 1065, the genuine test at 1552, the F841 at 1057), the three caller files and the not-yet-existing new test all resolve as described, and `a-crew-process-writes-only-what-it-owns#s6` resolves to a real section (it does not itself mention `tests/conftest.py`; that anchor was raised and answered by an earlier review and is not re-raised here).
rubric_items.done_when: a finding — the section's ruff-delta clause cannot be met by the rename it requires: renaming the helper makes its `# noqa: PT028` directive unused, which ruff reports as RUF100 on a staged path.
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — the done-when requires every gate log to open with its revision and literal command and close with a bare `EXIT=` line, and no log location is named that a later reader could not open; the run's own directory carries them under the dispatch contract.
rubric_items.naming: pass — `make_temp_config_home` and `tests/test_a_conftest_helper_is_never_collected.py` are named by what they do, with no plan label, stage name, ticket number or version tag.
rubric_items.reasoning: pass — the root cause reproduces exactly as stated (`pytest tests/conftest.py` gives `1 passed, 1 error`, `fixture 'prefix' not found` at conftest.py:1065), and the mechanism runs on the real path: `_node_test_files` (promotion_records.py:499) arms any write path for which `is_test_path` is true, which is true of `tests/conftest.py`, so the armed command does target the conftest.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — one deliverable (the helper rename, with its callers and its collection test) and one verdict closes it.
rubric_items.wiring: pass — s10 carries no depends-on and needs none (it repairs test collection hygiene in its own write paths), and the open followup f-aprteig-010 sequences it as the plan's one remaining instruction.
